backup.notABackup: That file isn't a trip backup.

backup.exportBody: The whole trip in one file: cities, stays, reservations, places, the plan and the queue. Keep it somewhere private, not in the public repo. Map pins from Google are left out, as its terms require; run maps:refresh after restoring to get them back.
backup.importEmpty: Restore a backup into this trip. Only works while the trip has nothing saved yet.
backup.importFull: This trip already has saved changes, so a backup can't be imported here. Create a new trip to restore into it.
